text: dsh-chatpaper 是面向 DSH 的 arXiv 论文工具插件，通过注册四个原生工具，让用户检索论文、提取论文正文并交给 Harness LLM 总结或翻译，也能依据检索结果生成文献综述。正文优先从 arXiv HTML 获取，必要时使用 ar5iv 或 PDF 提取；翻译和深度综述可作为后台任务运行。适合需要在 DSH 研究流程中查找、阅读和整理 arXiv 文献的用户。检索无需插件内 API key；总结、翻译和综述使用部署配置的 Harness LLM 服务。

dsh-chatpaper adds four DSH tools for arXiv search, paper summarization and translation, and literature surveys. It extracts paper text from arXiv HTML, with ar5iv and PDF fallbacks; translation and deep surveys can run as background jobs. LLM-backed tools use the configured Harness LLM service.
想直接在 DSH 里搜 arXiv 论文，并拿到标题、作者和摘要。
帮我把一篇 arXiv 论文提取正文后总结成中文。
I need a literature survey drafted from recent arXiv search results.
dsh-chatpaper 的功能「检索 arXiv」：调用 search_arxiv，输入自然语言关键词或 arXiv 查询语法，可限定近期天数和结果数量，返回论文标识、标题、作者、日期、分类、PDF 地址与摘要。
dsh-chatpaper 的功能「论文处理与综述」：可总结或分块翻译指定论文，也可根据检索结果撰写综述；翻译和综述支持后台运行。
dsh-chatpaper 使用前须知：搜索请求发送给 arXiv，正文从 arXiv 或 ar5iv 获取；总结、翻译和综述使用部署配置的 Harness LLM。插件不要求自有 API key。

dsh-chatpaper README · dsh-chatpaper：After DSH's release, I plan to gradually accumulate the tools I use frequently as DSH plugins.

ChatPaper has brought me a lot of convenience — it saves a great deal of time searching for papers and doing research. So, to adapt it into a DSH plugin, I spent some time modifying the code with AI and published it to GitHub, hoping to bring the same convenience to more people.

dsh-chatpaper README · dsh-chatpaper：arXiv paper tools for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH), provided as **native tools** — no Python, no MCP server. Paper text is extracted primarily from **arXiv's official HTML rendering** (LaTeXML), with ar5iv and PDF fallbacks.

dsh-chatpaper README · dsh-chatpaper：This project is a DSH plugin port referencing [ChatPaper](https://github.com/kaixindelele/ChatPaper): the tool contracts and query logic are kept consistent, but it now runs directly on DeepSeek Harness's native interfaces. See [Acknowledgments](#acknowledgments) at the end for the source and citation.

dsh-chatpaper README · Tools：| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `search_arxiv` | Search arXiv. Natural language (e.g. "agent as a judge") is matched as an `all:` phrase, falling back to an AND match over its content words when nothing is found; native arXiv query syntax (`ti:transformer`, `cat:cs.CL AND all:agent`) passes through untouched. |
| `summarize_paper` | Download a paper, extract its text, and summarize it with an LLM under fixed headings (Background, Methods, Results, Conclusions). |
| `translate_paper` | Translate a paper's full text chunk by chunk; long papers can run in the background. |
| `generate_survey` | Write a literature survey from search results — abstract-level (fast) or full-text deep mode (one summary per paper, concurrent, background-capable). |

dsh-chatpaper README · Tools：Background runs (`run_in_background: true`) register standard DSH jobs: the call returns a job id immediately, and after completion the result (or failure detail) is retrieved with the harness's built-in `job_output` tool. A single read is capped at 20000 bytes.

dsh-chatpaper README · Tools：`search_arxiv` needs no API key. The three LLM-backed tools use the **harness LLM service** (`ctx.llm`) — the provider, model, credentials, retry policy, and routing configured on the web Models page are all reused directly, with nothing to configure inside the plugin. When `provider`/`model` are left empty, they resolve at call time to the deployment's deepseek route and its default model; explicit configuration takes precedence.

dsh-chatpaper README · Install：From npm (prebuilt, no install-time build authorization needed):

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-chatpaper
```

From GitHub source (runs a `prepare` build; pnpm requires an `allowBuilds` grant in the profile's `pnpm-workspace.yaml` — the npm route is preferred):

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> add github:puppet2004/dsh-chatpaper
```

The bundle registers one `chatpaper` row; after installation, every session of that profile sees these 4 tools.

dsh-chatpaper README · Configuration：Add or override the row in your profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: chatpaper
      name: dsh-chatpaper
      config:

dsh-chatpaper README · Configuration：| Key | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `provider` | `''` | Harness LLM provider route; empty resolves to the deployment's deepseek route (`deepseek-official` in the official deployment). |
| `model` | `''` | Harness LLM model id; empty resolves to the adapter's advertised default model. |
| `cacheDir` | `~/.dsh-chatpaper-cache` | Paper-body cache directory, keyed by versioned arXiv id. |
| `surveyConcurrency` | `4` | Concurrent per-paper summaries in deep survey mode. |
| `summaryChars` | `15000` | Text slice fed to a summary. |
| `surveyPaperChars` | `8000` | Text slice fed to a deep-survey per-paper summary. |
| `translateChunkChars` | `6000` | Size of one translation chunk. |
| `translateMaxChars` | `60000` | Cap on source characters to translate. |
| `searchDelayMs` | `3000` | Delay before each arXiv API request (rate-limit courtesy). |
| `searchRetries` | `3` | arXiv API retry count. |
| `downloadTimeoutMs` | `120000` | Paper-body download timeout. |

dsh-chatpaper README · How paper text is fetched：1. **Official HTML** — `https://arxiv.org/html/<versioned-id>`; structured extraction preserves section headings and math (`<math alttext>` → LaTeX).
2. **ar5iv** — `https://ar5iv.labs.arxiv.org/html/<id>` for older papers without official HTML.
3. **PDF fallback** — `pdfjs-dist` text extraction for papers with no HTML at all.

dsh-chatpaper README · How paper text is fetched：Each tier's output is validated (an empty shell or fewer than 200 extracted characters falls through to the next tier). Extracted text is cached, so repeated calls are instant.

dsh-chatpaper README · What the model sees：4 native tools with their declared schemas. `search_arxiv` returns structured paper metadata (id, title, authors, date, categories, pdf URL, abstract) rendered as a numbered list. The LLM tools return structured results whose render shows the summary/translation/survey text; surveys also carry an `[n]`-indexed reference list.

dsh-chatpaper README · Token and KV-cache effects：Tool schemas are fixed, so the model-facing definition prefix is stable across requests. Tool results are plain text; no binary or image payloads enter context. Paper bodies are truncated (`summaryChars`/`surveyPaperChars`/`translateMaxChars`) before every LLM call, keeping prompts bounded. Cache hits avoid re-downloading and re-extracting entirely.

dsh-chatpaper README · Acknowledgments：This project is a port of the open-source **ChatPaper** project. The search query logic, paper-summarization prompts, and survey workflow follow the original design, re-implemented on DeepSeek Harness native interfaces (`ctx.llm`, `ctx.tools`, `ctx.jobs`). Thanks a lot for ChatPaper's work. If you use this plugin or build on it, please also cite the original project:
